Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

ski noun and verb

also skiing, ski instructor, ski jump, ski lift, ski lodge, ski run, ski slope, slalom, put on skis, wax skis, chairlift, chair lift

modern

Traupman 49, 380, 404
M-O s.v. ski

narta, nartae f.

noun, first declension

Other words

  • nartāre — ski (the verb)

    modern · Traupman 49, 380; M-O s.v. ski

  • tēlepherica sellāris — chairlift

    also used · modern · Traupman 288

    a ski jumpTraupman 49

    ski jumpingTraupman 49

  • anabathrum nartātōrium

    a ski liftTraupman 49

  • casa nartātōrum

    a ski lodgeTraupman 49

  • curriculum nivāle

    a ski runTraupman 49

    a ski slopeTraupman 49

    a slalomTraupman 49
